Page number top left.; One narrow printed column of numbers, set between two vertical rules, with a second column of numbers to its right; partly cut at the left edge with the running head fragment "E R P T" at top. page.notes: Left-side year numbers are partly smudged; several readings such as "Asscatades", "Lamparts", "Lampridss", "Pannias" and "Sofarmus" are uncertain. The page continues beyond this part. Left-hand numbers (30, 40, 45, 25, 32, 20, 19, 27) are printed beside the right-hand column of section numbers (3644 to 4019); the running head fragment at top reads only partly ("E R P T"), cut at the edge. Several rows are blank on one side. Lower part of the page is blank. Right-hand numbers are a separate column belonging to the entries. The final word "fine" is printed in italic below the last line. Several words are partly unclear in the scan and are marked [?].
